name: muloka-claude-plugins
description: muloka's Claude Code plugins — jj (Jujutsu) workflows, code review, and Rust code quality

plugins.name: project-setup-jj
plugins.description: Bootstrap jj (Jujutsu) workflow enforcement for any Claude Code project with a single /project-setup command

plugins.name: commit-commands-jj
plugins.description: Commands for jj (Jujutsu) commit workflows including commit, push, and PR creation — requires project-setup-jj, which supplies the raw-git wall these commands assume

plugins.name: peer-review-jj
plugins.description: Unified change review for jj repos — generalist-first with emergent specialists, two-phase pipeline, structured findings

plugins.name: workspace-jj
plugins.description: Enables Claude Code worktree isolation for jj (Jujutsu) repositories using jj workspaces

plugins.name: agent-helpers-jj
plugins.description: Machine-level jj (Jujutsu) query shortcuts for agents — read-only helpers that bake in --ignore-working-copy so concurrent workspaces don't race

plugins.name: rust-quality
plugins.description: Rust code-quality specialist for peer-review-jj — catches the recurring failure modes generic reviewers miss
